desc:
🐾 Start as a tiny animal, eat to grow and EVOLVE through 15 tiers into a giant Dragon, Kraken, Yeti and more! Explore 5 wild lands, team up in packs and beat huge bosses!

🍎 Eat orbs and critters to fill your bar and evolve
🌍 5 lands: Forest, Desert, Snow, Ocean & Sky - each with its own 15-tier path
⚔️ Battle other players - every animal has its own special ability
🐺 Team up in a pack with up to 4 friends
👹 Boss fights, admin abuse events and Double XP nights
🧬 95+ animals, skills, skins and daily rewards
💾 Your animal saves when you leave (but not if you leave mid-fight!)

🎁 JOIN the group for 3 FREE Revives!
👍 Every Like Goal unlocks a new code in-game!
🎮 Phone, tablet, PC and console
